conflicts.fact: What the Kericho record counts: 20 years or 20 days
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2's overview says 14 rainy days 'in 20 years'. The fact sheet says 20 days observed in total, 1 day per year, so this is consistent. Lesson 5 describes 'rain on one year's March day' and 'last 20 years' consistently. No conflict was confirmed, so this entry is low-confidence.

conflicts.fact: Handling of storm in the two-day model
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8's model step labels one-day P(rain) = 0.7 (rain or storm), while lessons 6 and 9 use 'rain only' = 0.6 with storm separate. Lesson 9 Card 2 writes the sample space S = {rain only, storm, dry}, while the fact sheet and lessons 3-4 write S = {rain, storm, dry}. The naming of the sample space differs slightly.
